blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — DND Construction and Penrex Suns kept their unbeaten records intact, improving to 2-0 in the Nevermind Basketball League Season 1 after beating their respective opponents, while TBT Basketball registered its first win of the campaign. DND Construction turned back DC Abay-Abay, 83-75, behind James Cubcuban’s game-high 27 points, while Penrex Suns outlasted All Out Squad, 76-73, in overtime to also secure their second straight victory during the weekend games held at the Subangdaku Sports Complex.
